name: Spritzer Bhd
summary: Spritzer Bhd, an investment holding company, engages in the production and sale of bottled water in Malaysia and internationally. It operates through three segments: Manufacturing, Trading, and Others. The company offers natural mineral water, carbonated flavored water, distilled water, drinking water, non-carbonated flavored water, preforms and bottles made of polyethylene terephthalate (PET), caps, toothbrushes, and other plastic products. It is also involved in the trade and distribution of bottled water and other consumer products; the operation of recreational parks and mini golf courses; and development and investment in properties.
